# PRIME H770-PLUS D4

#### B760M-AJ D4

###### ASUS Prime series motherboards are expertly engineered to unleash the full potential of 13 th Gen Intel ® Core™ Processors. Boasting a robust power design, comprehensive cooling solutions and intelligent tuning options, PRIME B760M-AJ D4 provides users and PC DIY builders with a range of performance optimizations via intuitive software and firmware features. 

 

- ###### 1 x DisplayPort 
- ###### 2 x HDMI ® ports 
- ###### PS/2 combo port 
- ###### 2 x USB 2.0 ports(Type-A) 
- ###### 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports(Type-A) 
- ###### 2 x USB 2.0 ports(Type-A) 
- ###### Realtek 2.5G Ethernet 
- ###### Vertical M.2 slot (Key E) 
- ###### 3 x Audio Jacks 
- ###### Expansion Slots • 1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 (max @x16 mode) SafeSlot Core+ • 1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 (@x4 mode) • 1 x PCIe 4.0 x1 
- ###### 2 x Addressable Gen 2 headers 
- ###### DDR4 support • Dual Channel • OptiMem II 
- ###### Intel ® LGA 1700 Socket: Ready for 13 th and 12 th Gen Intel ® processors 
- ###### 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header 
- ###### 2 x M.2 slots • 1 x M.2 2280 (PCIe 4.0 x4 mode) • 1 x M.2 2280 (PCIe 4.0 x4 mode) 
- ###### 2 x Aura RGB headers 
- ###### 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header

...

#### DDR4 Support

###### Improvements to trace routing design provide the latest Intel ® processors with enhanced access to memory bandwidth. ASUS OptiMem II technology carefully maps memory signal pathways across different PCB layers to reduce path distance, and it adds shielding zones that significantly reduce crosstalk.

...

## Storage

#### Two M.2 Slots (up to 64 Gbps) 

###### The PRIME B760 motherboard offers a total of two M.2 slots that support data-transfer speeds of up to 64 Gbps via PCIe 4.0, enabling quicker boot-up and app load times with OS or application drives. 

 *Actual transmission speeds will be lower than the theoretical maximum speed. 

 

## Connectivity

- PCIe 4.0 Slot 
- 2.5 Gb Ethernet 

 

#### PCIe 4.0 Slot

###### The PRIME B760 motherboard is designed specifically for 13 th and 12 th Gen Intel ® CPUs and offer PCIe 4.0 connectivity for the latest GPUs.

#### Realtek 2.5 Gb Ethernet

###### Realtek 2.5 Gb Ethernet reduces CPU overhead and offers exceptionally high TCP and UDP throughput for faster, smoother data transfers.
